# THE WINDOW OF ONE MODEL (curator, GH #888; a policy per role, GH #892). This
# cell decides what the model behind the hive sees on every call and keeps the
# record of what it saw:
#
#   * the hot path (`win-hashes` -> `win`): the system part is the `slots` the
#     ledger holds (plus the pins and the tool stubs of the current plan) and
#     the slots of the call's own session it was parked with, sent only when a
#     family changed and then as a `$replace` root -- the families that carry
#     rows of a round (`history`, `pinned`) and those that hold a session's
#     slots (`roster`, `consult`, `instructions`) on every call (GH #925);
#     the messages are
#     the wall after the plan's cover, in `seq` order, over every session
#     (OR-KX-K4), each shown the way the plan says. Deterministic, no model call.
#     Between two rebuilds only the END of the window moves (OR-KX-G4) -- a
#     provider's prefix cache keys on exactly that, so everything that changes a
#     block in the middle (a release, a shrunk tool result, a stub, a pin moving
#     into the system part, an expiry) is decided at a rebuild and nowhere else.
#   * the record: one `calls` row and its `call_blocks` per call, written in
#     the same emission as the call itself, BEFORE the brain has it. A block the
#     window shows in another form than the wall holds it (its short id in
#     front, a one-line form) is a block of kind `view`, so the record names
#     only blocks the ledger holds and rebuilds the request byte for byte.
#   * the tap (`tap`): the usage the brain reported fills that row later, and
#     a stamped `cache_expires_at` orders the clock: ONE standing order under a
#     fixed id, re-armed per call (`add` with `rearm`, GH #904), carrying the
#     call's round to the rebuild it starts (GH #925).
#   * the rebuild (`rb-*`, `sum`): when the cache has gone cold or the prompt
#     crossed `compress_at` of the usable window (the model's window, at most
#     `quality_cap`), the plan of the window is made anew from the role's
#     knobs (`window_plan`): the segments in the horizon in their tier form,
#     the newest `keep_recent` rounds raw, the model's own releases and pins
#     applied, and -- when the plan is still over `rebuild_to` of the usable
#     window -- old tool results shrunk, unused tools stubbed and the summary
#     given up, in that order. A summary is made by `./summarizer` -- never in
#     the hot path, at most one rebuild at a time (OR-KX-K5), and a failed
#     summary leaves the window as it was (OR-KX-K6).
#

# THE AUDIENCE GATE (GH #925). Every row of `wall`, `calls`, `marks`,
# `summaries` and `pins` carries the audience of the round that caused it
# (`audience_set`, a canonical JSON array), and a reader hands a row to a round
# iff the row has one and it names `*` or holds the round as a subset -- the
# affinity rule (templates/affinity/README.md, GH #154/#306). The round is
# `context.audience_set` of the message being served: this hive's edges set
# and delete only `cur_*`, so it rides the context through every ledger round
# trip exactly like `cur_origin`, and it is never guessed from a row. These
# functions are the same text in every cell of this hive that writes or reads
# rows; a lock holds them to one table.


def audience_of(value):
    """An audience in its canonical form -- a JSON array of strings, sorted,
    no duplicates, no whitespace -- or None when there is none. The round
    arrives as TEXT (a JSON array in a string) and a column comes back as
    text; a list is taken as it is. Absent, empty text, a scalar or
    unparsable text is NOT DECLARED: the empty list is a declared round, None
    is no round at all (affinity `as_set`, GH #306)."""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        if not value.strip():
            return None
        try:
            value = json.loads(value)
        except ValueError:
            return None
    if not isinstance(value, list):
        return None
    return json.dumps(sorted({str(x) for x in value if str(x)}), separators=(",", ":"))


def allowed(round_value, origin):
    """The gate: a row whose audience is `origin` may reach the round
    `round_value` iff both are declared and the origin names `*` or holds the
    round as a subset. A row from before the rule has no origin and never
    leaves (OR-BD-5); a round nobody declared passes nothing."""
    r, o = audience_of(round_value), audience_of(origin)
    if r is None or o is None:
        return False
    o = set(json.loads(o))
    return "*" in o or set(json.loads(r)) <= o


def passes(row, round_value, session):
    """One reader's verdict on one row. With a declared round it is the gate;
    without one, only a row of the running session that declares no round
    either (or names `*`) passes -- the window and the handover keep a
    round-less conversation going and show nothing from elsewhere (OR-BD-4).
    A row of a declared round never reaches a call nobody declared a round
    for, though it stands in the same session (review M-7: the words of {e,b}
    reached a round-less call of that session, and a round-less recall took
    the addendum of an {e,a} gap). A row that names no session never passes
    a round-less read."""
    if audience_of(round_value) is None:
        if not session or str(row.get("session_id") or "") != session:
            return False
        own = audience_of(row.get("audience_set"))
        return own is None or "*" in json.loads(own)
    return allowed(round_value, row.get("audience_set"))


def audience_meet(values):
    """The audience of a row made of other rows (a summary, a handover
    block): the INTERSECTION of its sources, so it can never be wider than
    any of them (OR-BD-3). A source naming `*` is neutral; one source without
    an audience, or no source at all, makes the result None."""
    out, universal = None, False
    for v in values:
        c = audience_of(v)
        if c is None:
            return None
        s = set(json.loads(c))
        if "*" in s:
            universal = True
            continue
        out = s if out is None else out & s
    if out is None:
        return '["*"]' if universal else None
    return json.dumps(sorted(out), separators=(",", ":"))


# The round this message serves (GH #925, OR-BD.A.1): `context.audience_set`,
# read anew at every step and never from a row. Lower case on purpose: the
# pure half is loaded with the upper-case constants and without a context

def with_audience(row, value):
    """An insert row with the audience `value` in its canonical form, or
    without the key when there is none -- the column stays NULL and the row
    reaches no round (OR-BD-5); the round itself goes on."""
    aud = audience_of(value)
    if aud is not None:
        row = dict(row, audience_set=aud)
    return row

def canonical(value):
    """The one serialisation a block is hashed and stored in: keys sorted,
    UTF-8, no whitespace."""
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)


def block_hash(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical(value).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def block_span(text):
    """Where an answer's sidecar block stands: (start, end) or None.

    The boundary is the fence `talky/splitter` cuts (GH #379, #605): the
    ```sidecar fence, or the legacy ```memory fence, to the next closing fence
    or to the end of the text when the completion stopped inside the block.
    Measured, never parsed -- the sections inside are somebody else's business.
    """
    low = text.lower()
    for fence in ("```sidecar", "```memory"):
        at = low.find(fence)
        if at < 0:
            continue
        head = text.find("\n", at)
        close = text.find("```", head + 1) if head >= 0 else -1
        if head >= 0 and close >= 0:
            return at, close + 3
        return at, len(text)
    return None


def stripped_text(text):
    span = block_span(text)
    if span is None:
        return text
    return (text[:span[0]] + text[span[1]:]).strip()


def element_of(row):
    """The element a wall row stands for: `element` when the caller has it,
    else the block body the ledger stored."""
    el = row.get("element")
    if isinstance(el, dict):
        return el
    try:
        el = json.loads(str(row.get("body") or ""))
    except Exception:
        return None
    return el if isinstance(el, dict) else None


def plan_cover(plan, cover_rows):
    """Where the window's wall starts: the cover of the current plan, or --
    in a ledger that has none yet -- the newest summary's `covers_to_seq`."""
    if isinstance(plan, dict) and plan.get("cover") is not None:
        try:
            return int(plan.get("cover") or 0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            pass
    return int((cover_rows[0].get("covers_to_seq") or 0) if cover_rows else 0)


def short_id(h):

def norm_id(value):
    """A block id as a model writes it -- `#0123456789ab`, `[#0123...]`,
    bare -- as its 12 hex digits, or "" when it is none."""
    s = str(value or "").strip().strip("[]").strip().lstrip("#").strip().lower()
    s = s[:12]
    if len(s) != 12 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in s):
        return ""
    return s


def epoch_ms(value):
    """A stamped time as epoch milliseconds: RFC 3339 text, or a number of
    seconds (milliseconds above 1e12). None when it reads as neither."""
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        return int(value if value > 1e12 else value * 1000)
    s = str(value or "").strip()
    if not s:
        return None
    try:
        t = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if t.tzinfo is None:
        t = t.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    return int(t.timestamp() * 1000)


def epoch_us(value):
    """A stored stamp as epoch microseconds -- the unit of `wall.seq`, so a
    pin that arrived between two rows stands between them."""
    s = str(value or "").strip()
    try:
        t = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if t.tzinfo is None:
        t = t.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    delta = t - datetime.datetime(1970, 1, 1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    return (delta.days * 86400 + delta.seconds) * 1000000 + delta.microseconds


def prefixable(el):
    """What carries a short id and a one-line form: somebody else's words and
    a tool result (see ID_HEX)."""
    typ = el.get("type")
    return typ == "tool_result" or (typ == "text" and el.get("origin") in ("user", "peer"))


def first_line(text, cap):
    for line in str(text or "").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if line:
            return line if len(line) <= cap else line[:cap].rstrip() + " ..."
    return ""


def expired(el, as_of_ms):
    """A transient block (`valid_until` stamped by whoever made it) whose time
    ran out before the plan was made."""
    until = epoch_ms(el.get("valid_until")) if isinstance(el, dict) else None
    return until is not None and as_of_ms is not None and until <= as_of_ms


def render(rows, params=None, plan=None, current=None, tail=None):
    """Every message of the window, in order: `(position, element, hash, view)`.

    Four rules, all deterministic in their input:
    * a final answer of the model shows its sidecar block when the block is at
      most `sidecar_max_chars` long and the answer without it otherwise (GH #871:
      without a precedent in the earlier answers the block quote fell from 98 %
      to 38 %);
    * a tool call without its result, or a result without its call, in the same
      turn is left out -- a malformed pair is a refused request for every
      provider;
    * outside the running round (`current`, one `(session_id, turn_id)`), a
      block the plan released, shrank or found expired is shown in its one-line
      form (GH #892);
    * with short ids on, somebody else's words and a tool result begin with
      `[#<12 hex>] `, the id of the wall block (GH #892).
    `view` is true where the element differs from the block the wall holds.
    `tail` is `(position, element)` of the pins that arrived after the plan,
    shown where they arrived."""
    params = params if isinstance(params, dict) else {}
    cap = params.get("sidecar_max_chars", SIDECAR_MAX_CHARS)
    cap = SIDECAR_MAX_CHARS if cap in (None, "") else int(float(cap))
    short = flag_of(params, "short_ids") if params else SHORT_IDS
    plan = plan if isinstance(plan, dict) else {}
    released = set(plan.get("released") or [])
    shrunk = set(plan.get("shrunk") or [])
    as_of = plan.get("as_of_ms") if plan else None
    ordered = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: int(r.get("seq") or 0))
    calls, results = {}, {}
    for r in ordered:
        el = element_of(r)
        if el is None:
            continue
        key = (str(r.get("session_id") or ""), str(r.get("turn_id") or ""))
        if el.get("type") == "tool_call":
            calls.setdefault(key, set()).add(str(el.get("id") or ""))
        elif el.get("type") == "tool_result":
            results.setdefault(key, set()).add(str(el.get("id") or ""))
    out = []
    for r in ordered:
        el = element_of(r)
        if el is None:
            continue
        key = (str(r.get("session_id") or ""), str(r.get("turn_id") or ""))
        eid = str(el.get("id") or "")
        if el.get("type") == "tool_call" and eid not in results.get(key, set()):
            continue
        if el.get("type") == "tool_result" and eid not in calls.get(key, set()):
            continue
        wid = short_id(r.get("hash") or block_hash(el))
        h = str(r.get("hash") or "") or block_hash(el)
        if str(r.get("kind") or "") == "assistant" and int(r.get("final") or 0) == 1:
            text = str(el.get("text") or "")
            span = block_span(text)
            if span is not None and span[1] - span[0] > cap:
                el = dict(el, text=stripped_text(text))
                h = block_hash(el)
        view = False
        if prefixable(el):
            text = str(el.get("text") or "")
            form = None
            if plan and key != current:
                if wid in released:
                    form = RELEASED_FORM % (wid, wid)
                elif wid in shrunk and el.get("type") == "tool_result":
                    form = SHRUNK_FORM % (wid, first_line(text, LINE_CHARS), wid)
                elif expired(el, as_of):
                    form = EXPIRED_FORM % wid
            if form is not None:
                el = dict((k, v) for k, v in el.items() if k != "valid_until")
                el["text"] = form
                view = True
            elif short:
                el = dict(el, text="[#%s] %s" % (wid, text))
                view = True
        if view:
            h = block_hash(el)
        out.append((int(r.get("seq") or 0), el, h, view))
    for pos, el in (tail or []):
        out.append((int(pos), el, block_hash(el), True))
    out.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    return out


def window_items(rows, params=None, plan=None, current=None, tail=None):
    """(element, hash) of every message of the window, in order."""
    return [(el, h) for _, el, h, _ in render(rows, params, plan, current, tail)]


def history_window(rows, params=None):
    """The window messages of a wall sequence (rows with `seq`, `kind`,
    `final`, `session_id`, `turn_id`, `hash` and `element` or `body`), rule
    #871 included, short ids as the params' role says. Pure: no I/O, no clock,
    no state -- and no plan: the window between two rebuilds."""
    return [el for el, _ in window_items(rows, params)]


def path_key(path):
    return tuple(path.split("."))


def family_hashes(leaves):
    """One hash per top-level family over its (path, block hash) pairs."""
    fams = {}
    for path, _, h in leaves:
        fams.setdefault(path.split(".")[0], []).append([path, h])
    return {f: block_hash(sorted(v)) for f, v in fams.items()}


def family_node(fam, leaves):
    """A whole family as ONE `$replace` root: every leaf it holds, the
    collector's and the pack's alike -- `$replace` drops the subtree before the
    upsert, so a family is never sent with half its leaves."""
    node = {"$replace": True}
    for path, text, _ in sorted(leaves, key=lambda x: path_key(x[0])):
        parts = path.split(".")
        if parts[0] != fam:
            continue
        if len(parts) == 1:
            node["text"] = text
            continue
        at = node
        for seg in parts[1:-1]:
            at = at.setdefault(seg, {})
        at[parts[-1]] = {"text": text}
    return node


def session_bound(path):
    """Whether `path` is a slot of one session (SESSION_SLOTS, review I-4):
    the path itself or one below it."""
    return any(path == p or path.startswith(p + ".") for p in SESSION_SLOTS)


def session_slots_of(slim):
    """The `(path, text)` slots of the call's own session, parked by
    `./intake` with the turn (`session_slots`); anything that is not a pair of
    texts on a session path is no slot."""
    out = []
    for pair in slim.get("session_slots") or []:
        if isinstance(pair, list) and len(pair) == 2 and all(isinstance(x, str) for x in pair) \
                and session_bound(pair[0]):
            out.append((pair[0], pair[1]))
    return out


def leaf_binding(value):
    """`(hash, audience)` of the state that binds a leaf of `history` to its
    audience -- `handover_audience` for the handover leaf, `summary_audience`
    for the summary leaf -- or None. Its writer puts it as canonical JSON
    `{"audience": <audience text or null>, "hash": <hash of the leaf's
    block>}` in the bundle that writes the leaf, so the audience names the
    leaf it was made for: the store does not roll a failed leg of a bundle
    back, and two `new` flows that overlap left one flow's leaf under the
    other's audience (review I-1); a `sum` bundle whose slot leg failed left
    the old summary under the new one's audience (review R2-I-4). Any other
    value -- the plain audience of before, broken JSON, no hash -- binds
    nothing."""
    try:
        v = json.loads(value or "")
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if not isinstance(v, dict) or not isinstance(v.get("hash"), str) or not v.get("hash"):
        return None
    aud = v.get("audience")
    return v["hash"], (aud if isinstance(aud, str) else None)


def stub_text(text):
    """A tool declaration cut to its name and one line (GH #892, Lehre Stufe
    4): the description's first line, and `parameters` an EMPTY object schema
    -- a provider refuses a declaration without one."""
    try:
        tool = json.loads(text)
    except Exception:
        return text
    if not isinstance(tool, dict):
        return text
    fn = tool.get("function") if isinstance(tool.get("function"), dict) else tool
    stub = {"name": str(fn.get("name") or ""),
            "description": first_line(fn.get("description"), LINE_CHARS),
            "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {}}}
    if isinstance(tool.get("function"), dict):
        stub = {"type": tool.get("type") or "function", "function": stub}
    return json.dumps(stub)


def pin_split(pins, blocks, plan, now_ms_value):
    """The pins other hives set, split by where they stand (`broadcast_mode`):
    in the system part as `pinned.<source>.<id>` leaves, or -- `tail`, arrived
    after the plan -- as a message where they arrived. A pin whose `until` ran
    out before the plan was made is gone; the model's own pins are no leaves."""
    plan = plan if isinstance(plan, dict) else {}
    made = epoch_us(plan.get("at")) if plan else None
    as_of = plan.get("as_of_ms") if plan else None
    leaves, tail = [], []
    for p in sorted(pins, key=lambda p: (str(p.get("at") or ""), str(p.get("hash") or ""))):
        source = str(p.get("source") or "")
        h = str(p.get("hash") or "")
        if source == MODEL_SOURCE or not h:
            continue
        el = element_of(blocks.get(h) or {})
        if el is None:
            continue
        text = str(el.get("text") or "")
        until = epoch_ms(p.get("until"))
        arrived = epoch_us(p.get("at")) or 0
        if BROADCAST_MODE == "system":
            gone_at = as_of if as_of is not None else now_ms_value
            if until is not None and until <= gone_at:
                continue
            leaves.append(("pinned.%s.%s" % (source, short_id(h)), text))
        elif made is not None and arrived <= made:
            if until is not None and as_of is not None and until <= as_of:
                continue
            leaves.append(("pinned.%s.%s" % (source, short_id(h)), text))
        else:
            msg = PIN_FRAME % (source, text)
            if SHORT_IDS:
                msg = "[#%s] %s" % (short_id(h), msg)
            tail.append((arrived, {"origin": "user", "type": "text", "text": msg}))
    return leaves, tail


# ================================================================ THE PLAN
def topic_move(value):
    """The movement of a `topic` mark, or "". Its value is the canonical JSON
    `{"movement", "name"}` that `./intake` writes (OR-KY-71); the window cuts
    its segments on the movement alone."""
    try:
        v = json.loads(value or "")
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return ""
    return str(v.get("movement") or "") if isinstance(v, dict) else ""


def day_of(at):
    ms = epoch_ms(at)
    if ms is None:
        return None
    return datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ms / 1000.0, datetime.timezone.utc).date().toordinal()


def read_from(prev):
    """Which wall rows a rebuild has to see, as a store filter: everything after
    the previous plan's cover -- the rows the model can see (with the pinned
    ones below it, read by hash), so every id it names is among them. A cover
    only ever moves forward; what lies below it is summarised or gone."""
    return {"seq": {"gt": int(prev.get("cover") or 0)}}


def summary_holds(prev, as_of_ms):
    """Whether the previous summary may be carried on: everything it covers is
    still in a `summary` tier. Without a `none` tier nothing ever leaves one;
    with a day horizon its first row's day says it (a `seq` is microseconds);
    with another horizon the rows below the cover are not read, and the
    summary is carried on (OR-KY.T.6)."""
    if "none" not in TIERS:
        return True
    if HORIZON != "day":
        return True
    first = int(prev.get("sum_from") or 0)
    if first <= 0:
        return False
    day = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(first / 1e6, datetime.timezone.utc).date().toordinal()
    today = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(as_of_ms / 1000.0,
                                            datetime.timezone.utc).date().toordinal()
    return tier_at(today - day) == "summary"


def ages_of(rows, topic, as_of_ms):
    """The age of every row's segment, by `seq` (0 = the running segment).

    `day`: the UTC calendar day of the row, counted back from the day of the
    plan. `task`: a segment opens at the first row of a round a `topic` mark
    `start` was said in, after a round a `topic` mark `end` was said in, and at
    a day change; the age counts segments back from the newest. `all`: every
    row is older than the running segment -- the rolling window of 1.0.0."""
    ages = {}
    if HORIZON == "all":
        return dict((int(r["seq"]), 1) for r in rows)
    if HORIZON == "day":
        today = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(as_of_ms / 1000.0,
                                                datetime.timezone.utc).date().toordinal()
        for r in rows:
            day = day_of(r.get("at"))
            ages[int(r["seq"])] = max(0, today - day) if day is not None else 0
        return ages
    starts, ends = set(), set()
    for m in topic:
        key = (str(m.get("session_id") or ""), str(m.get("turn_id") or ""))
        value = topic_move(m.get("value"))
        if value == "start":
            starts.add(key)
        elif value == "end":
            ends.add(key)
    seg, seg_of, last_key, last_day, closed = 0, {}, None, None, False
    for r in rows:
        key = (str(r.get("session_id") or ""), str(r.get("turn_id") or ""))
        if key != last_key:
            day = day_of(r.get("at"))
            if last_key is not None and (key in starts or closed
                                         or (day is not None and last_day is not None
                                             and day != last_day)):
                seg += 1
            if key not in seg_of:
                seg_of[key] = seg
            closed = key in ends
            last_key, last_day = key, day if day is not None else last_day
        ages[int(r["seq"])] = seg_of.get(key, seg)
    for s in ages:
        ages[s] = seg - ages[s]
    return ages


def tier_at(age):
    return TIERS[min(max(age, 0), len(TIERS) - 1)]


def pin_audience(mark, h, rows):
    """The audience of a pin the model asks for (GH #925, review C-1), as a
    PURE function: the meet of the `pin` mark (the round it was said in) and
    of EVERY wall row of the pinned hash the rebuild read (`rows` + `kept`) --
    never the round of the rebuild, which is merely the newest call's. A row
    from before the rule or a mark without an audience makes it None, and so
    does a hash the rebuild read no row of (fail-closed): the pin row keeps
    no audience and reaches no round (OR-BD-5)."""
    auds = [r.get("audience_set") for r in rows if str(r.get("hash") or "") == h]
    if not auds:
        return None
    return audience_meet([(mark or {}).get("audience_set")] + auds)


def window_plan(rows, topic, trim, pins, prev, as_of_ms, slots=(), kept=(), cw=0):
    """The plan of the window a rebuild makes, as a PURE function (GH #892).

    rows   wall rows of the range (`read_from`): seq, session_id, turn_id,
           iter, kind, hash, at, and from their blocks `chars`, `type`, `name`
    topic  `topic` marks of the range; trim: `release`/`pin` marks after the
           previous plan's `marks_to`
    pins   every `pins` row; kept: wall rows outside the range the model pinned
    prev   the previous plan (cover, keep, released, shrunk, stubs, summary,
           sum_from, sum_to, marks_to)
    slots  `(path, hash, chars)` of the system part; cw the model's window

    Returns the new plan, the rows to condense (`todo`, empty = no summarizer
    call), whether the previous summary leads the transcript (`chain`), the
    model pins to add (each with its audience, `pin_audience`) and drop, and
    the lines to say."""
    rows = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: int(r.get("seq") or 0))
    notes = []

    def key_of(r):
        return (str(r.get("session_id") or ""), str(r.get("turn_id") or ""))

    # -- the model's own releases and pins, oldest first -------------------
    model_pins = set()
    for p in pins:
        if str(p.get("source") or "") == MODEL_SOURCE:
            model_pins.add(str(p.get("hash") or ""))
    ids = {}
    for r in list(rows) + list(kept):
        ids.setdefault(short_id(r.get("hash")), set()).add(str(r.get("hash") or ""))
    rounds_of = {}
    for r in list(rows) + list(kept):
        rounds_of.setdefault(short_id(r.get("hash")), set()).add(key_of(r))
    slot_ids = set(short_id(h) for _, h, _ in slots)
    released = set(prev.get("released") or [])
    # `pin_aud[i]` is the audience of `pin_add[i]` (review C-1).
    pin_add, pin_drop, pin_aud = [], [], []
    groups, order = {}, []
    for m in sorted(trim, key=lambda m: int(m.get("seq") or 0)):
        k = key_of(m)
        if k not in groups:
            groups[k] = []
            order.append(k)
        groups[k].append(m)
    marks_to = int(prev.get("marks_to") or 0)
    for k in order:
        # A pin and a release of one id in one block: the pin wins -- keeping
        # is the side a wrong guess costs least on (review focus 2).
        for m in sorted(groups[k], key=lambda m: 0 if m.get("kind") == "release" else 1):
            marks_to = max(marks_to, int(m.get("seq") or 0))
            mid = norm_id(m.get("value"))
            what = str(m.get("kind") or "")
            if not mid:
                notes.append("%s of %r: not a block id -- ignored" % (what, m.get("value")))
                continue
            if mid in slot_ids and mid not in ids:
                notes.append("%s of #%s: identity, persona and instructions stay -- ignored"
                             % (what, mid))
                continue
            hashes = ids.get(mid)
            if not hashes:
                notes.append("%s of #%s: no such block in the window -- ignored" % (what, mid))
                continue
            if what == "release":
                if rounds_of.get(mid, set()) <= set([k]):
                    notes.append("release of #%s: a block of the round it was said in stays"
                                 " -- ignored" % mid)
                    continue
                released.add(mid)
                for h in sorted(hashes):
                    if h in model_pins:
                        model_pins.discard(h)
                        pin_drop.append(h)
            else:
                released.discard(mid)
                for h in sorted(hashes):
                    if h not in model_pins:
                        model_pins.add(h)
                        pin_add.append(h)
                        pin_aud.append(pin_audience(m, h, list(rows) + list(kept)))

    # -- segments, tiers, the raw suffix -----------------------------------
    ages = ages_of(rows, topic, as_of_ms)
    tier = dict((int(r["seq"]), tier_at(ages.get(int(r["seq"]), 0))) for r in rows)
    firsts, seen = [], set()
    for r in rows:
        if key_of(r) not in seen:
            seen.add(key_of(r))
            firsts.append(key_of(r))
    recent = set(firsts[-KEEP_RECENT:]) if KEEP_RECENT > 0 else set()
    if firsts:
        # The newest round is never cut: it may be the one the next call runs.
        recent.add(firsts[-1])
    raw = [int(r["seq"]) for r in rows if tier[int(r["seq"])] == "raw" or key_of(r) in recent]
    if raw:
        cover = min(raw) - 1
    elif rows:
        cover = int(rows[-1]["seq"])
    else:
        cover = int(prev.get("cover") or 0)
    older = [r for r in rows if int(r["seq"]) <= cover]
    in_sum = [r for r in older if tier[int(r["seq"])] == "summary"]
    sum_rows = [r for r in in_sum if str(r.get("hash") or "") not in model_pins]

    # -- the summary: carried on, grown, made anew, or given up ------------
    prev_sum = str(prev.get("summary") or "")
    chain = bool(prev_sum) and bool(prev.get("hash")) and summary_holds(prev, as_of_ms)
    if chain:
        todo = [r for r in sum_rows if int(r["seq"]) > int(prev.get("sum_to") or 0)]
        sum_from = int(prev.get("sum_from") or 0)
        sum_to = max([int(prev.get("sum_to") or 0)] + [int(r["seq"]) for r in todo])
        summary = "pending" if todo else prev_sum
    else:
        todo = list(sum_rows)
        sum_from = int(todo[0]["seq"]) if todo else 0
        sum_to = int(todo[-1]["seq"]) if todo else 0
        summary = "pending" if todo else ""

    # -- what stays raw below the cover: the model's pins ------------------
    keep = sorted(set(int(r["seq"]) for r in list(older) + list(kept)
                      if str(r.get("hash") or "") in model_pins))
    shown = set(short_id(r.get("hash")) for r in rows if int(r["seq"]) > cover)
    shown |= set(short_id(r.get("hash")) for r in list(rows) + list(kept)
                 if int(r["seq"]) in set(keep))
    released = set(i for i in released if i in shown)
    shrunk, stubs = set(), []

    # -- the aim: `rebuild_to` of the usable window ------------------------
    usable = [x for x in (int(cw or 0), QUALITY_CAP) if x > 0]
    target = REBUILD_TO * min(usable) if usable and REBUILD_TO > 0 else 0

    held = sum(int(c or 0) for path, _, c in slots if path == SUMMARY_PATH)

    def estimate():
        n = sum(STUB_CHARS if path.startswith("tools.") and path[6:] in stubs else int(c or 0)
                for path, _, c in slots if path != SUMMARY_PATH)
        # A summary to be made counts with its whole budget, a kept one as it is.
        n += SUMMARY_BUDGET if summary == "pending" else (held if summary else 0)
        for r in rows + list(kept):
            s = int(r["seq"])
            if s <= cover and s not in keep:
                continue
            i = short_id(r.get("hash"))
            n += FORM_CHARS if (i in released or i in shrunk) else int(r.get("chars") or 0)
        return n / float(CHARS_PER_TOKEN)

    newest = firsts[-1] if firsts else None
    if target and estimate() > target and KEEP_ROUNDS > 0:
        iters = []
        for r in rows:
            if int(r["seq"]) > cover and r.get("type") == "tool_result":
                it = key_of(r) + (int(r.get("iter") or 0),)
                if it not in iters:
                    iters.append(it)
        keep_iters = set(iters[-KEEP_ROUNDS:])
        for r in rows:
            it = key_of(r) + (int(r.get("iter") or 0),)
            if (int(r["seq"]) > cover and r.get("type") == "tool_result" and it not in keep_iters
                    and key_of(r) != newest and str(r.get("hash") or "") not in model_pins):
                shrunk.add(short_id(r.get("hash")))
    if target and estimate() > target and STUB_TOOLS_AFTER > 0 and len(firsts) >= STUB_TOOLS_AFTER:
        late = set(firsts[-STUB_TOOLS_AFTER:])
        called = set(str(r.get("name") or "") for r in rows
                     if key_of(r) in late and r.get("type") == "tool_call")
        stubs = sorted(path[6:] for path, _, _ in slots
                       if path.startswith("tools.") and path[6:] not in called)
    if target and estimate() > target and summary:
        notes.append("the plan is over rebuild_to of the usable window -- the summary is given up")
        todo, summary, sum_from, sum_to, chain = [], "", 0, 0, False
    shrunk -= released

    plan = {"v": 1, "role": ROLE, "as_of_ms": int(as_of_ms), "cover": cover, "keep": keep,
            "released": sorted(released), "shrunk": sorted(shrunk), "stubs": stubs,
            "summary": summary, "sum_from": sum_from, "sum_to": sum_to, "marks_to": marks_to}
    return {"plan": plan, "todo": todo, "chain": chain and bool(todo),
            "pin_add": pin_add, "pin_audience": pin_aud, "pin_drop": pin_drop, "notes": notes}


def transcript_of(todo, blocks, prev, chain, round_value):
    """What a rebuild hands `./summarizer`, as a PURE function (GH #925): the
    plan is made over every row (it moves the cover and nothing leaves the
    cell), the TEXT only of rows the round of the rebuild may see. A chained
    summary goes in, and counts as a source, on the same terms. Returns the
    transcript lines, the hashes that went in, their audiences (for the
    summary's own, `audience_meet`), and the rows that went in."""
    lines, sources, auds, went = [], [], [], []
    if chain and allowed(round_value, prev.get("sum_audience")):
        el = element_of(blocks.get(str(prev.get("hash") or "")) or {})
        if el is not None:
            lines.append("Summary of the exchange before this part:\n" + str(el.get("text") or ""))
            lines.append("")
            sources.append(str(prev.get("hash")))
            auds.append(prev.get("sum_audience"))
    for r in todo:
        # A rebuild serves no session: without a round nothing passes, and
        # `./policy` never gets here without one.
        if not passes(r, round_value, ""):
            continue
        el = element_of(blocks.get(str(r.get("hash") or "")) or {})
        if el is None:
            continue
        lines.append(transcript_line(str(r.get("kind") or ""), el))
        sources.append(str(r.get("hash") or ""))
        auds.append(r.get("audience_set"))
        went.append(r)
    return lines, sources, auds, went


def transcript_line(kind, el):
    text = str(el.get("text") or "")
    if kind in ("tool_call", "recall", "brief") and el.get("type") != "tool_result":
        try:
            fn = json.loads(text) or {}
        except Exception:
            fn = {}
        return "assistant called %s(%s)" % (fn.get("name") or "?", fn.get("arguments") or "")
    if kind in ("tool_result", "recall", "brief"):
        if len(text) > TRANSCRIPT_TOOL_CHARS:
            text = text[:TRANSCRIPT_TOOL_CHARS] + " [cut]"
        return "tool result: " + text
    if kind == "assistant":
        return "assistant: " + stripped_text(text)
    if kind == "peer":
        who = str(el.get("speaker") or el.get("speaker_ref") or "")
        return ("peer %s: " % who if who else "peer: ") + text
    if kind in ("advice", "delegation"):
        return "note: " + text
    return "user: " + text


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime(FMT)


def now_ms():
    return int(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp() * 1000)


def iso_z(ms):
    """Epoch milliseconds as the timer's `at`: RFC 3339, UTC, rounded UP to the
    second -- the timer refuses an `at` that is already past."""
    return datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(-(-int(ms) // 1000),
                                           datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def emit(msgs):
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(msgs))
    sys.exit(0)


def park(reason=""):
    if reason:
        sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: %s\n" % reason)
    emit([])


def lstore(ops, phase, call="", reason=""):
    return {"header": {"route": "lstore", "phase": phase, "reply_cell": ME,
                       "cur_call": call, "cur_reason": reason},
            "messages": [{"origin": "assistant", "type": "tool_call", "id": cid,
                          "text": json.dumps(args)} for cid, args in ops]}


def legs(body):
    out = {}
    for m in body.get("messages") or []:
        if not isinstance(m, dict):
            continue
        try:
            payload = json.loads(m.get("text") or "null")
        except Exception:
            payload = None
        out[str(m.get("id") or "")] = {"payload": payload, "error_code": "",
                                       "rows_affected": 0}
    results = body.get("results")
    if isinstance(results, list):
        for r in results:
            if not isinstance(r, dict):
                continue
            leg = out.setdefault(str(r.get("tool_call_id") or ""),
                                 {"payload": None, "error_code": "", "rows_affected": 0})
            leg["error_code"] = str(r.get("error_code") or "")
            leg["rows_affected"] = int(r.get("rows_affected") or 0)
    elif len(out) == 1:
        leg = next(iter(out.values()))
        leg["error_code"] = str(hop.get("error_code") or "")
        leg["rows_affected"] = int(hop.get("rows_affected") or 0)
    return out


def rows(lg, cid):
    p = (lg.get(cid) or {}).get("payload")
    return p if isinstance(p, list) else []


def sel(table, columns, where=None, order=None, limit=None):
    a = {"operation": "select", "table": table, "columns": columns}
    if where:
        a["where"] = where
    if order:
        a["order_by"] = [{"col": c, "dir": o} for c, o in order]
    if limit:
        a["limit"] = limit
    return a


def ins(table, row):
    return {"operation": "insert", "table": table, "row": row}


def upd(table, values, where):
    return {"operation": "update", "table": table, "set": values, "where": where}


def state_of(lg, cid):
    return {str(r.get("key") or ""): str(r.get("value") or "") for r in rows(lg, cid)}


def loads(text, default):
    try:
        v = json.loads(text)
    except Exception:
        return default
    return v if isinstance(v, type(default)) else default

def report_errors(lg):

        if leg["error_code"]:

def probe(call, reason):
    """The first step of every rebuild: is this trigger current, and is
    another rebuild already running?"""
    return lstore([("p-state", sel("state", ["key", "value"],
                                   {"key": {"in": ["last_call", "rebuild_running",
                                                   "window_plan", "context_window"]}})),
                   ("p-sum", sel("summaries", ["id", "covers_to_seq", "hash", "at", "audience_set"],
                                 None, [("covers_to_seq", "desc")], 1))],
                  "rb-probe", call, reason)


def hash_reads(call, plan, cover_rows):
    """The reads `win-hashes` takes a call on with: the parked turn, the
    hashes of the wall after the plan's cover and of the rows the plan holds
    below it, of every slot and every pin, and the newest summary's cover --
    the set `./intake` hands a call on with (its step B). Built here only for
    a call that comes back from `./handover` (GH #896): the leaf it set is a
    slot now, and the window it is read into is the plan's, rows held and
    pins included (review I-1: a copy of this set in `./handover` read
    neither)."""
    plan = plan if isinstance(plan, dict) else {}
    cover = plan_cover(plan, cover_rows)
    keep = [int(x) for x in (plan.get("keep") or []) if str(x).lstrip("-").isdigit()]
    ops = [("b-slimq", sel("state", ["value"], {"key": "pending:" + call})),
           ("b-wallh", sel("wall", ["hash"], {"seq": {"gt": cover}}))]
    if keep:
        ops.append(("b-keeph", sel("wall", ["hash"], {"seq": {"in": keep}})))
    ops += [("b-slotsh", sel("slots", ["hash"])),
            ("b-pins", sel("pins", ["hash"])),
            ("b-cover", sel("summaries", ["covers_to_seq"], None,
                            [("covers_to_seq", "desc")], 1))]
    return ops


def cw_of(value):
    try:
        cw = int(float(value)) if value not in (None, "") else 0
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        cw = 0
    return cw if cw > 0 else CONTEXT_WINDOW


try:
    _VIEWS
except NameError:
    # The window forms this child has put into `blocks` (a cache of its own
    # writes, never the truth: `code` runner mode `resident`). A restarted
    # child starts empty and puts each form once more -- delete + insert, the
    # one idempotent put a store without a unique key has.
    _VIEWS = set()


def view_ops(views, stamp, held=()):
    """The window forms not yet in `blocks`: delete + insert each. A form whose
    hash is a block the ledger already holds for its own sake (`held`) is that
    block, and is left as it is."""
    ops = []
    for i, (el, h, kind) in enumerate(views):
        if h in _VIEWS or h in held:
            continue
        _VIEWS.add(h)
        ops.append(("v-d%d" % i, {"operation": "delete", "table": "blocks", "where": {"hash": h}}))
        ops.append(("v-i%d" % i, ins("blocks", {"hash": h, "kind": kind,
                                                "chars": len(str(el.get("text") or "")),
                                                "body": canonical(el), "first_seen": stamp})))
    return ops


def plan_of(state):
    return loads(state.get("window_plan", "") or "", {})


def prev_of(plan, sum_row):
    """What a rebuild starts from: the current plan, or -- in a ledger that
    has none -- the newest summary as 1.0.0 left it."""
    sid = str(sum_row.get("id") or "")
    if plan:
        prev = dict(plan)
    else:
        cover = int(sum_row.get("covers_to_seq") or 0)
        prev = {"cover": cover, "summary": sid, "sum_from": 0, "sum_to": cover,
                "released": [], "shrunk": [], "stubs": [], "keep": [], "marks_to": 0}
    prev["hash"] = str(sum_row.get("hash") or "") if prev.get("summary") == sid and sid else ""
    # GH #925: the audience of the summary a rebuild may chain -- it goes into
    # the next transcript only if the round of that rebuild may see it.
    prev["sum_audience"] = str(sum_row.get("audience_set") or "") if prev["hash"] else ""
    return prev


def old_window_kept(raw, pending_actions, why, failure):
    """The ops of a rebuild that ends without a summary (OR-KX-K6): the window
    stays what it was, the lock is freed, and the next call says so
    (`rebuild_failed`) -- taken only if nobody added an action since."""
    sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: rebuild (%s) failed: %s -- old window kept\n"
                     % (why, failure.strip()))
    actions = loads(pending_actions, []) + ["rebuild_failed"]
    return [("s-free", upd("state", {"value": ""}, {"key": "rebuild_running", "value": raw})),
            ("s-act", upd("state", {"value": canonical(actions)},
                          {"key": "actions_pending", "value": pending_actions}))]


def finish(info, result, why, pending_actions, raw, stamp, extra_ops=(), extra_actions=()):
    """The ops that make a plan the window: the plan itself, the model's pins,
    the summary slot when the summary was given up, the call's actions, the
    lock freed."""
    plan = dict(result["plan"])
    prev = info.get("prev") or {}
    if plan.get("summary") and plan.get("summary") == prev.get("summary") \
            and "sum_shown" not in plan and prev.get("sum_shown") is not None:
        # A summary carried on keeps what its head names (review M-1): a
        # summary chained from it alone names the same.
        plan["sum_shown"] = prev.get("sum_shown")
    ops = list(extra_ops)
    ops.append(("f-plan", upd("state", {"value": canonical(plan)}, {"key": "window_plan"})))
    # GH #896: the handover leaf stands until the first rebuild after it.
    ops.append(("f-unleaf", {"operation": "delete", "table": "slots",
                             "where": {"path": HANDOVER_PATH, "owner": "curator"}}))
    if not plan.get("summary") and prev.get("summary") and info.get("slot_exists"):
        ops.append(("f-unsum", {"operation": "delete", "table": "slots",
                                "where": {"path": SUMMARY_PATH, "owner": "curator"}}))
    auds = result.get("pin_audience") or []
    for i, h in enumerate(result.get("pin_add") or []):
        # GH #925 (review C-1): a model pin reaches whom its mark and every
        # row of its block reach (`pin_audience`) -- not the round of this
        # rebuild, which is the newest call's. None leaves the column NULL.
        ops.append(("f-pin%d" % i, ins("pins", with_audience(
            {"hash": h, "source": MODEL_SOURCE, "until": "", "at": stamp},
            auds[i] if i < len(auds) else None))))
    if result.get("pin_drop"):
        ops.append(("f-unpin", {"operation": "delete", "table": "pins",
                                "where": {"hash": {"in": sorted(result["pin_drop"])},
                                          "source": MODEL_SOURCE}}))
    actions = loads(pending_actions, [])
    moved = [k for k in ("cover", "keep", "released", "shrunk", "stubs", "summary")
             if plan.get(k) != prev.get(k)]
    if moved or result.get("pin_add") or result.get("pin_drop") or extra_ops:
        actions.append("rebuild:" + why)
    actions += list(extra_actions)
    if prev.get("summary") and not plan.get("summary"):
        actions.append("summary:dropped")
    ops.append(("f-act", upd("state", {"value": canonical(actions)},
                             {"key": "actions_pending", "value": pending_actions})))
    ops.append(("f-free", upd("state", {"value": ""}, {"key": "rebuild_running", "value": raw})))
    return ops

        msg["messages"].insert(0, {

call = str(ctx.get("cur_call") or "")
reason = str(ctx.get("cur_reason") or "")

    if not slim:

if phase == "win-hashes":
    report_errors(lg)
    slim = loads(str((rows(lg, "b-slimq") or [{}])[0].get("value") or ""), {})
    plan = loads(str(slim.get("plan") or ""), {})
    cover = plan_cover(plan, rows(lg, "b-cover"))
    keep = [int(s) for s in (plan.get("keep") or [])]
    needed = sorted({str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in rows(lg, "b-wallh")}
                    | {str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in rows(lg, "b-keeph")}
                    | {str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in rows(lg, "b-slotsh")}
                    | {str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in rows(lg, "b-pins")})
    # GH #925: every row the window may show comes with its audience; the
    # audiences of the two leaves of `history` (`handover_audience`, written
    # by `./handover` beside its leaf, `summary_audience`, written by the
    # `sum` bundle beside the summary leaf -- each bound to its leaf's hash)
    # ride in the same bundle.
    cols = ["seq", "session_id", "turn_id", "iter", "kind", "hash", "nth", "final",
            "audience_set"]
    ops = [("w-wall", sel("wall", cols, {"seq": {"gt": cover}}, [("seq", "asc")])),
           ("w-slots", sel("slots", ["path", "hash", "owner"])),
           ("w-pins", sel("pins", ["hash", "source", "until", "at", "audience_set"])),
           ("w-state", sel("state", ["key", "value"],

                                           "handover_for", "handover_audience",
                                           "summary_audience", "pending:" + call]}}))]
    if keep:
        ops.append(("w-keep", sel("wall", cols, {"seq": {"in": keep}}, [("seq", "asc")])))
    if needed:

                                    {"hash": {"in": needed}})))

    slim = loads(state.get("pending:" + call, ""), {})

        park("call %s lost its parked turn -- no call" % call)
    if reason != "handover" and str(slim.get("session") or "") != state.get("handover_for", ""):
        # GH #896 (OR-KY-U1): the first call of a session this window did not
        # serve last goes through `./handover` once, without a model, and comes
        # back as `handover-done` -- the parked turn waits in `pending:<call>`.
        emit([{"header": {"route": "handover", "session_id": str(slim.get("session") or ""),
                          "turn_id": str(slim.get("turn") or ""), "curator_call": call},
               "messages": []}])
    plan = loads(str(slim.get("plan") or ""), {})
    blocks = {}
    for r in rows(lg, "w-blocks"):
        blocks.setdefault(str(r.get("hash") or ""), r)
    session = str(slim.get("session") or "")
    turn = str(slim.get("turn") or "")
    # THE GATE OF THE WINDOW (GH #925). The window reads every session
    # (OR-KX-K4); what it SHOWS is what the round may see -- a wall row whose
    # audience holds the round, and without a round only the running session
    # (OR-BD-4). A pin, the summary leaf and the handover leaf name no session:
    # they need a round their audience holds. The system part is gated BEFORE
    # its family hashes are made, so a family that loses a leaf leaves as a
    # `$replace` root and takes back what an earlier round was sent -- the
    # model's `llm` keeps `system.*` until it is replaced. The plan is not
    # gated: it is structure, and between two rebuilds only the end of the
    # window moves.
    # Each leaf of `history` passes only under the audience bound to ITS hash
    # (reviews I-1 and R2-I-4): a slot row of another hash -- the leaf of an
    # overlapping `new` flow, the summary of a `sum` bundle whose other leg
    # failed -- or an audience in any other form is no leaf, fail-closed.
    bound = {HANDOVER_PATH: leaf_binding(state.get("handover_audience", "")),
             SUMMARY_PATH: leaf_binding(state.get("summary_audience", ""))}
    wall, seen = [], set()
    for r in rows(lg, "w-keep") + rows(lg, "w-wall"):
        if int(r.get("seq") or 0) in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(int(r.get("seq") or 0))
        if not passes(r, the_round, session):
            continue
        b = blocks.get(str(r.get("hash") or ""))
        if b is None:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/policy: wall row %s has no block yet -- left out\n"
                             % r.get("seq"))
            continue
        wall.append(dict(r, body=b.get("body")))
    stamp = now()
    leaves, views = [], []
    stubs = set(plan.get("stubs") or [])
    for r in rows(lg, "w-slots"):
        h = str(r.get("hash") or "")
        b = blocks.get(h)
        el = element_of(b) if b else None
        if el is None:
            continue
        path, text = str(r.get("path") or ""), str(el.get("text") or "")
        if session_bound(path):
            # A session's slot from before review I-4: the call carries its own.
            continue
        if path in bound and (bound[path] is None or bound[path][0] != h
                              or not allowed(the_round, bound[path][1])):
            continue
        if path.startswith("tools.") and path[6:] in stubs:
            leaf = {"path": path, "text": stub_text(text)}
            h = block_hash(leaf)
            views.append((leaf, h, "system"))
            text = leaf["text"]
        leaves.append((path, text, h))
    pins = [p for p in rows(lg, "w-pins") if allowed(the_round, p.get("audience_set"))]
    pinned, tail = pin_split(pins, blocks, plan, now_ms())
    # The slots of this call's session come from its parked turn alone (review
    # I-4), a block of their own each like a pin leaf, so `call_blocks` names
    # what the ledger holds.
    for path, text in session_slots_of(slim) + pinned:
        leaf = {"path": path, "text": text}
        h = block_hash(leaf)
        views.append((leaf, h, "system"))
        leaves.append((path, text, h))
    leaves.sort(key=lambda x: path_key(x[0]))
    items = render(wall, P, plan, (session, turn), tail)
    views += [(el, h, "view") for _, el, h, view in items if view]
    fams = family_hashes(leaves)
    sent = loads(state.get("system_hash_sent", ""), {})
    changed = sorted(f for f in fams if sent.get(f) != fams[f])
    removed = sorted(f for f in sent if f not in fams)
    system = {}
    for f in changed:
        system[f] = family_node(f, leaves)
    for f in removed:
        system[f] = {"$replace": True}
    # THE GATED FAMILIES GO WHOLE, ON EVERY CALL (GH #925, review I-2). The
    # model's `llm` keeps ONE system tree, and it answers a call with what
    # that call's message left in it. Two calls of two rounds overlap (two
    # channels of one brain): each reads `system_hash_sent` before the
    # other's `done` lands, so a diff against it lets A's leaf -- a summary
    # only A's round may see -- stand when B is answered. A state keyed per
    # round alone would not close that: B still reads it before A writes it.
    # So the families that carry rows of other rounds are sent in every call
    # as their whole `$replace` root, empty when the round sees nothing; the
    # same leaves are the same text, so the provider's prefix cache stays.
    # The families that hold a session's slots go whole for the same reason
    # (review I-4): the `llm` keeps the legend, the consults and the peer rule
    # of whichever call came last, so each call sends its own, empty included.
    # The other families hold neither and keep the diff.
    for f in GATED_FAMILIES + SESSION_FAMILIES:
        system[f] = family_node(f, leaves)
    pending_actions = state.get("actions_pending", "")
    actions = loads(pending_actions, [])
    if changed or removed:
        actions.append("system:" + ",".join(changed + removed))
    try:
        it = int(str(slim.get("iter") or "0"))
    except ValueError:
        it = 0
    ops = view_ops(views, stamp, blocks)
    ops.append(("f-call", ins("calls", with_audience({
        "call_id": call, "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn, "iter": it,
        "trigger": "curate", "started_at": stamp, "model": "", "tokens_prompt": None,
        "tokens_completion": None, "tokens_cached": None, "tokens_cache_write": None,
        "cost": None, "cache_expires_at": "", "system_hash": block_hash(fams),
        "actions": actions}, the_round))))
    if audience_of(the_round) is None:
        # OR-BD-4: a call without a round says so, once, beside its record --
        # the mark has no audience of its own.
        ops.append(("f-noaud", ins("marks", {
            "seq": epoch_us(stamp), "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn,
            "kind": "missing_audience", "value": call, "at": stamp})))
    listed = [h for _, _, h in leaves] + [h for _, _, h, _ in items]
    for pos, h in enumerate(listed):
        ops.append(("f-b%d" % pos, ins("call_blocks", {"call_id": call, "pos": pos, "hash": h})))
    if changed or removed:
        ops.append(("f-sent", upd("state", {"value": canonical(fams)},
                                  {"key": "system_hash_sent"})))
    if actions and pending_actions not in ("", "[]"):
        # Taken only if nobody added one since it was read.
        ops.append(("f-act", upd("state", {"value": "[]"},
                                 {"key": "actions_pending", "value": pending_actions})))
    ops.append(("f-drop", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                           "where": {"key": "pending:" + call}}))
    head = dict(slim.get("hop") or {})
    head["route"] = "brain"
    head["curator_call"] = call
    for k, v in (("session_id", session), ("turn_id", turn), ("iter", str(it))):
        if k not in head:
            head[k] = v
    out = {"header": head, "messages": [el for _, el, _, _ in items]}
    if system:
        out["system"] = system
    if "tool_scope" in slim:
        out["tool_scope"] = slim.get("tool_scope")
    emit([lstore(ops, "done", call, ""), out])

    state = state_of(lg, "b-state")
    stash = loads(state.get("pending:tap-" + call, ""), {})
